description: Create a recurring VPS schedule: action restart, start, stop or command (runs `command` through the QEMU guest agent). Five-field cron, evaluated in `timezone` (IANA, default UTC), at most every 5 minutes. Requires confirm=true. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

serviceId.description: ID of the VPS: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_vservers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.

name: create_vserver_schedule
title: Create VPS Schedule
